landing.kicker: AI assistant for pleading preparation — France & the OHADA area
landing.description: Plaid'IA analyses opposing submissions, times a pleading plan, simulates the judge's objections and checks procedure, with, on the most sensitive analyses, several independent checks that verify each answer before it is displayed.
landing.descAnalyser: Each argument broken down as a syllogism — legal issue, applicable rule, application to the facts — with a risk level and possible rebuttals.
landing.descChat: Ask a precise question, get a structured answer based on the active jurisdiction — with, on the most sensitive questions, multi-agent verification before display.
landing.descPlan: Hook, timed points, conclusion — a plan ready for the courtroom, set to the allotted speaking time.
landing.descSimulateur: Anticipate the judge's or opposing party's trickiest questions, with a response lead for each.
landing.descChronologie: Rebuilds a case's timeline from its documents, including the period covered and any missing elements.
landing.descVerification: Identified deadlines with their status, potentially missing procedural filings, points of attention.
landing.etape1Titre: Create a case — or try the demo
landing.etape1Description: A fictional, already-filled employment-law case is ready to explore, no sign-up or setup needed.
landing.etape2Titre: Paste your documents or describe the situation
landing.etape2Description: Opposing submissions, hearing notes, a free-form question: the input format adapts to whatever you have on hand.
landing.etape3Description: Every answer flags its own limits — never a claim presented as settled without solid grounds.
landing.modeDemo: This public instance runs in demo mode — the demo uses a fictional case and pre-recorded answers, independent of any API key.
landing.sixEspaces: Six workspaces, one same principle: verify before asserting
landing.altJustitia: Statue of Justice holding a scale, low-angle shot
landing.ceQueLoutilNeFeraJamais: What the tool will never do
landing.gardeFouIntro1: On the most sensitive analyses, the agent drafting the answer is never the sole judge of its own response. Before it reaches the screen, five independent checks examine it each from a different angle — and every claim stays flagged
landing.gardeFouIntro2: until one of them has been able to confirm it.
landing.etapeSecuriteTexte: Screens the request — off-topic, ambiguous or manipulative — before it reaches an analysis agent.
landing.etapeSecuritePhotoAlt: Ancient metal armour, dimly lit in the shadows
landing.etapeIntentionTexte: Understands what is actually being asked, and determines whether the question calls for in-depth verification.
landing.etapeIntentionPhotoAlt: Dart stuck in the centre of a dartboard, on a dark background
landing.etapeVerifJuridiqueTexte: Checks every cited reference against sources that actually exist — never a rubber-stamp confirmation.
landing.etapeVerifJuridiquePhotoAlt: Statuette of Justice, a judge's gavel and an open law book
landing.etapeCritiqueTexte: Plays devil's advocate: actively looks for weaknesses in the reasoning, as the opposing party would.
landing.etapeCritiquePhotoAlt: Two chess pieces, king and queen, facing each other on a chessboard
landing.etapeValidationTexte: Consolidates the previous two checks into a clear status — never inventing a source to fill a gap.
landing.etapeValidationPhotoAlt: "VALID" stamp applied to an approval request
landing.gardeFouOutro: Several independent checks don't automatically make an answer correct — they help catch errors, contradictions and open points sooner. Plaid'IA always distinguishes what is verified, what is probable, and what remains uncertain.
landing.footerAssistant: Pleading preparation assistant for lawyers and clerks, France and the OHADA area.
landing.projetPortfolio: Portfolio project, Abdoulaye Sadio, NLP / Computational Linguistics
landing.aucuneDonneeDemo: No data is kept in demo mode.

confidentialite.chapeau: Plaid'IA is a publicly accessible portfolio project — here is, honestly, what happens when you enter text into the app.

donnees.intro: No data entered into Plaid'IA is sold, shared for advertising purposes, or sent to any third party other than those listed here.
donnees.anthropic: Anthropic (Claude) — receives the text sent to generate a response, for every real analysis or question (outside demo mode). It is the only provider used for the legal analysis itself, pleading generation and the chat.
donnees.deepseek: NVIDIA (hosting the DeepSeek model) — optional, used only if an NVIDIA key is configured on the server, for a few tasks that structure already-provided content (key-element extraction, case summary).
donnees.judilibre: Judilibre / Legifrance — optional, used only if you enable live search or case-law collection, to query these public databases (no data from your case is sent to them, only search terms).
donnees.aucunAutre: No other third-party service receives your data. No advertising tracking, no resale of usage analytics to third parties.

entrainement.texte: Under Anthropic's current commercial API terms (check anthropic.com/legal, as it may change), data sent via the API is not used to train their models by default. Plaid'IA has no control over a third-party provider's actual practices: this page reflects our understanding of their public policy, not a contractual guarantee we can make on their behalf.

modeDemo.texte: On a public deployment with no API key configured server-side (the case for the live demo), no data you enter ever reaches Anthropic or any other provider: answers are pre-recorded, and the database is reset every time the server restarts.

clePersonnelle.texte: If you provide your own Anthropic key to leave demo mode, it stays stored only in your browser (sessionStorage, cleared when the tab closes), sent with each request in an HTTP header, and is never logged or stored server-side.

anonymisation.texte1: On "Analyze opposing submissions", a checkbox lets you pseudonymize detected person names in the text before it reaches Anthropic (guardrail, analysis agent, verifier and critic included) -- each name becomes "Person A", "Person B"...
anonymisation.texte2: Detection happens entirely on the server, with no external call to spot names: they never reach a third party for this step. The result shown on screen and saved in your case file, however, shows the real names -- only what is actually sent to the model stays masked.
anonymisation.limite: An honest limit: detection is a heuristic (civility title + "First Last" pattern), not a trained named-entity-recognition tool. It can miss a name with no obvious marker, or wrongly flag a proper noun that isn't a person. Use it to reduce risk, never as a guarantee of full anonymity.

jurisprudence.texte: Any decision collected automatically (live search, Judilibre collection) stays "pending" and is never citable by the assistant until a lawyer has manually validated it.

perimetre.texte1: Plaid'IA is a personal portfolio project, not an audited product backed by a data processing agreement (DPA) with its providers. This page describes how the app actually works, not a binding legal commitment.
perimetre.texte2: If you're considering real use with data covered by professional secrecy, verify Anthropic's (and, where relevant, NVIDIA's) current terms yourself before any use, and don't enter anything you wouldn't be comfortable leaving your machine.

contact.texte: A question about this page or how Plaid'IA works? Reach out via the GitHub or LinkedIn profile listed in the homepage footer.
